ai_result.long_description:
Built for dependable everyday wear, this handmade men's belt is crafted from thick, 100% genuine full-grain leather in classic deep black. Its 1.57 inches / 40 mm width gives it a substantial profile suited to workwear, denim and office outfits.

The belt features a durable silver-tone metal buckle, hand-stitched keepers, and hand-cut, hand-finished edges for a smooth, premium feel. Its minimalist, rugged design is easy to style and made to develop a distinctive patina over time as the natural leather ages.

To choose your size, measure a belt you already wear from the fold where the buckle is attached to the hole you use most often. Use that measurement as your belt size. Please contact us if you need help choosing the right fit.

This timeless leather belt also makes a practical gift for birthdays, anniversaries, Father's Day or Christmas.
